description: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores of three different models, namely MADLLM, an unspecified model represented by a purple bar, and MADLLM without skip embedding, across five datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The horizontal axis lists these datasets in the order SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, while the vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)" and ranges from 80 to 100 in increments of 10. For each dataset, three bars are grouped together, colored green for MADLLM, purple for the unspecified model, and orange for MADLLM without skip embedding. The F1 scores for MADLLM range from approximately 91% for SWaT to 97% for PSM, with the other datasets having scores around 93-94%. The purple bars have values between approximately 85% for SWaT and 94% for PSM, and the orange bars range from about 85% for SWaT to 93% for PSM. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
